name: discord-openrouter-chatbot
description: Discord chatbot powered by OpenRouter-compatible models with slash-command UX

scripts.check: node --check bot.js && node --check commands.js && node --check bot-data.js && node --check deploy-commands.js
scripts.service:install: mkdir -p ~/.config/systemd/user && cp systemd/discord-bot.service ~/.config/systemd/user/ && systemctl --user daemon-reload && systemctl --user enable --now discord-bot
